page.title: Bring the whole crew.
page.subtitle: Turn a group-night promotion into the right ticket path or a useful sales conversation.

sections.heading: From group invitation to useful sales handoff
sections.text: Proposed journey, not the Islanders’ deployed stack. Official team imagery; illustrative campaign, records and integrations. Focused app mockups, not account screenshots. A/B mark source-to-screen matches. Clock is illustrative staging.

steps.text: **Start with the invitation.** The fan sees the group-night email; Content Builder shows the same creative, button and campaign destination. This is a proposed campaign, not a live offer.
**Follow the promise.** Plan your group night opens this campaign landing page—not a generic homepage. The two choices let the organizer ask for planning help or explore ticket options.

**Check the source against the screen.** Contentful holds the same official group photo and A headline shown on the phone. B is the planning CTA. These custom fields and their website mapping are proposed.

**Ask for useful context.** The example organizer requests planning help for 24 people and hospitality. This is still a form, not a lead or a booking. Routing follows the request type, not an invented group-size threshold.

**Submit the planning request.** In this proposed handoff, Sales Cloud receives the campaign, group size and preferences. Compare the phone acknowledgement with the lead record: inquiry received does not mean seats reserved.
**Give sales a useful next action.** The lead is still open and not contacted. The proposed task is to discuss hospitality and game preferences; no quote, reservation or response deadline is implied.
**Take the other path.** This fan chooses Tickets only. The proposed campaign route does not create a planning inquiry just because someone clicked a link.

**Hand off to ticketing.** A configured Ticketmaster destination would own availability and checkout. This preview stops at the handoff: no group discount, inventory, payment or purchase is simulated.
